title: Airbus H145 救援直升機
summary: 以H145救援直升機的公共用途作情境，分析任務設備、旋翼盤面、電力和振動的通用工程關係；不模擬救援飛行操作。十個單元依序進行機制、定量、量測與診斷，每單元可改一個變數比較結果。
summaryEn: Use the H145 public rescue role to analyze generic relationships between mission equipment, rotor disk, power and vibration without rescue-flight simulation procedures. Ten units each progress through mechanism, calculation, measurement and diagnosis, with a one-variable comparison.
scope: 公開原理支持的原創航空教學。每個數值均明示為假設模型，非同名機型實際性能、維修手冊、製造工藝、取證判據或飛行操作。任務在模型完成，不提供武器、軍用性能最佳化或真機操作指示。
scopeEn: Original aviation teaching based on public principles. Every numerical example is an explicit hypothetical model, not named-aircraft performance, maintenance data, manufacturing process, certification criterion or flight operation. Tasks run in models, excluding weapons, military-performance optimization and aircraft operating instructions.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 救援設備的質量位置：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Rescue-equipment mass location: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 救援設備的質量位置 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Rescue-equipment mass location and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 重心是質量加權位置，增加設備的影響取決於質量和力臂；總重量與重心必須同時計算。
steps.instructionEn: Centre of gravity is a mass-weighted position; added equipment depends on mass and arm, so total mass and centre of gravity must be tracked together.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非Airbus H145 救援直升機實際性能或製程：m1=1000 kg、x1=2 m；m2=200 kg、x2=4 m。式 xcg=Σmixi/Σmi，基準結果 2.33333333 m。適用條件：單軸固定基準教學模型，沒有提供任何機型重心限制。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not measured performance or a process for Airbus H145 rescue helicopter: m1=1000 kg at x1=2 m and m2=200 kg at x2=4 m. Formula xcg=Σmixi/Σmi gives 2.33333333 m. Conditions: Single-axis fixed-datum teaching model without aircraft-specific centre-of-gravity limits.
steps.failure: 只在質量表加入物件卻忘了力矩，或混用不同基準會使重心錯誤。
steps.failureEn: Adding mass without moment or mixing datums corrupts the centre-of-gravity result.
steps.check: 先固定基準與正方向，核對所有配載是否包含在質量和力矩兩張表。
steps.checkEn: Fix datum and sign first and verify every item appears in both mass and moment ledgers.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「Airbus H145 救援直升機」的「救援設備的質量位置：機制與觀察」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出機體、能源、感測、控制與地面驗證的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「風洞值班：把曲線說清楚」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與試件構型、質量或負載表、原始量測與需求版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Rescue-equipment mass location: Mechanism and observation” in “Airbus H145 rescue helicopter”. Draw the airframe, energy, sensing, control and ground-verification interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Wind-Tunnel Shift: Explain the Curves” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for specimen configuration, mass/load manifest, raw measurements and requirement version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

steps.title: 總重量與盤面需求：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Weight and disk demand: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 總重量與盤面需求 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Weight and disk demand and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 理想懸停動量理論以推力、密度和盤面積求誘導速度；葉片輪廓阻力與尾流不均未包含在內。
steps.instructionEn: Ideal hover momentum theory estimates induced velocity from thrust, density and disk area; profile drag and nonuniform wake are excluded.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非Airbus H145 救援直升機實際性能或製程：T=1000 N，ρ=1.2 kg/m³，A=10 m²。式 vi=√[T/(2ρA)]，基準結果 6.45497224 m/s。適用條件：理想孤立均勻致動盤、靜止空氣，僅非飛行教育模型。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not measured performance or a process for Airbus H145 rescue helicopter: T=1000 N, rho=1.2 kg/m³ and disk area A=10 m². Formula vi=√[T/(2ρA)] gives 6.45497224 m/s. Conditions: Ideal isolated uniform actuator disk in still air, solely a non-flying educational model.
steps.failure: 把理想誘導功率當整機總功率會低估能量需求。
steps.failureEn: Treating ideal induced power as total aircraft power understates demand.
steps.check: 記錄盤面積和總推力，將誘導功率Tvi與總功率分開，說明輪廓與傳動損失。
steps.checkEn: Record disk area and total thrust, separate Tvi from total power, and identify profile and drivetrain losses.
